tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Title bar and sidebar — the window frame that sits behind the content area.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Main content area: toolbar, download table, empty states, settings page.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised layer: details panel, text fields, table header, status bar.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Overlays: dialogs, menus, tooltips. Always paired with a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, nav items and subtle buttons. Overlaid on any surface.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed wash on rows, nav items and subtle buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table rows and the current sidebar item. Always combined with the selection indicator bar and the checked checkbox, never colour alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the window behind a modal dialog.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row separators, panel edges, toolbar bottom. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Dialog and menu outlines; section dividers in Settings.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of text fields, checkboxes, number boxes, secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 on every surface, including surface-selected, in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: filenames, headings, values. On every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hostnames, sizes, column headers, labels. ≥4.5:1 on every surface and on surface-selected.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, helper hints, the em dash for unavailable values. ≥4.5:1 on surface-000…300 and surface-selected.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast minimums; pair with the disabled cursor and aria-disabled).

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Maximum-contrast marks: the focus ring's inner line, window-control glyphs on hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fetchlane teal. Primary button fill, active progress fill, selection indicator bar, checked controls.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, checked checkbox). Never literal white in dark theme.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Teal used as text or icon: links, the Downloading status label and icon. ≥4.5:1 on surface-100/200.

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: Downloading: label + down-arrow icon + teal bar.

tokens.name: status-queued
tokens.usage: Queued: label 'Queued · #n' + clock icon; no bar fill.

tokens.name: status-paused
tokens.usage: Paused: label + pause icon; bar fill uses progress-paused.

tokens.name: status-retry
tokens.usage: Automatic retry in progress (transient): label 'Retrying in 8 s' + circular-arrow icon + dashed amber bar. Amber means 'Fetchlane is handling it'.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Persistent failure needing the person: label 'Failed · reason' + alert icon + red bar. ≥4.5:1 on surface-100/200 and on error-bg.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Completed: label + check icon. Never shown as colour alone; completed rows have no bar.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Background of an inline error explanation (details panel, dialog validation).

tokens.name: retry-bg
tokens.usage: Background of an automatic-retry explanation.

tokens.name: done-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the completed summary in the details panel.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of every progress bar.

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Active download fill.

tokens.name: progress-paused
tokens.usage: Fill of a paused download (keeps its position, loses its colour).

tokens.name: progress-retry
tokens.usage: Fill of a download waiting to retry.

tokens.name: progress-error
tokens.usage: Fill of a failed download, showing how much partial data is kept.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring outside a 1px gap in the surface colour (Windows 11 style). Drawn outside the control, so it always lands on a surface: ≥3:1 on surface-000…300 and surface-selected.

tokens.name: caption-close
tokens.usage: Window close button hover fill (Windows convention), with white glyph.

families.ui: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.display: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Page title (Settings), empty-state headline, dialog title.

styles.name: text-subtitle
styles.usage: List heading above the table; details-panel filename.

styles.name: text-body-strong
styles.usage: Filenames in the table (comfortable), button labels, settings group labels.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Copy a download link, then press Ctrl+V.
styles.usage: Default UI text, field values, explanations.

styles.name: text-row
styles.usage: Table cells, status labels, compact-density filenames (at weight 600).

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Hostnames under filenames, column headers, helper text, status bar, title bar.

styles.name: text-metric
styles.usage: Changing numbers: sizes, speeds, time left. Always font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and right-aligned so digits don't jitter.

styles.name: text-metric-lg
styles.usage: Percentage in the details panel. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: text-mono
styles.usage: URLs and folder paths in the details panel and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside compact controls; bar-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, icon-to-label in buttons, cell inner gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; sidebar item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Content gutters: toolbar, table, details panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog body padding at 960 px window width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between Settings groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars, checkbox, selection indicator bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, nav items, rows' hover wash, menu items (Windows 11 control radius).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, the details-panel info blocks, the app window.

size.note: Fixed layout dimensions. Density changes row-height only; everything else is constant.

tokens.name: titlebar-height
tokens.usage: Custom title bar; caption buttons are 46 × 32.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Main toolbar (Add download, search, Pause all).

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom summary bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar at window width ≥ 1100 px.

tokens.name: sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Icon rail with count badges below 1100 px.

tokens.name: details-width
tokens.usage: Details panel; docked at ≥ 1200 px, overlays the table below that.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Table row, comfortable density (default): filename + hostname on two lines.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table row, compact density: one line, hostname moves to tooltip.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, number boxes.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Row action buttons and selection-toolbar buttons in compact density.

tokens.name: shadow-flyout
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, the overlaid details panel.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs.
